  that persist when the browser is closed is planned.
- Interface available in English (default), Simplified Chinese, Spanish,
  Hindi, Arabic (right-to-left layout), and Russian.
- Indicative multi-currency displays in USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, AUD, IDR,
  INR, and CNY, plus gold and silver values per troy ounce, gram, and kilogram.
- A Gold Market Fear / Pullback Index that averages the existing 0–100 rule
  scores across the 11 gold-related Signal Board assets. It measures breadth
  and persistence of recent declines; it is not a forecast or probability.
- A free iframe widget builder at /embed/; the parameterized /widget/ output
  shows the latest scheduled close and remains noindex to avoid thin pages.
- Installable Progressive Web App metadata and service-worker caching.

## Data sources
- Real-time charts and news: TradingView (third-party, free embed with
  predictions, or buy/sell recommendations for real money.

## Articles
Thirty-one educational articles are published under /articles/ and indexed at
/articles.html. The September 15, 2026 editorial expansion adds ten source-led,
answer-first guides:
- "Gold Price per Gram and Kilogram: The Exact Formula" — troy-ounce conversion,
  currency conversion, retail premiums, and a worked example.
- "Troy Ounce vs. Regular Ounce" — the measurement distinction that prevents
  almost ten-percent conversion errors.
- "Spot Gold vs. Futures vs. Bullion Price" — what each price represents and why
  the three related numbers do not match exactly.
- "Why the Gold Price Differs by Currency" — the two-part gold and foreign-
  exchange calculation behind local returns.
- "Live Gold Price vs. Daily Close" — which observation fits live context,
  signals, comparisons, backtests, and record-keeping.
- "How to Read the Gold Market Fear and Pullback Index" — exact components,
  score bands, limitations, and interpretation.
- "Real Interest Rates and Gold" — opportunity cost, TIPS real-yield proxies,
  timing alignment, and reasons the relationship can break.
- "How the U.S. Dollar Affects the Gold Price" — translation, safe-haven, yield,
  and local-currency channels.
- "Gold Market Hours, Daily Closes and Weekend Prices" — venue breaks, frozen
  weekend quotes, opening gaps, and different closing conventions.
- "How to Embed a Gold Price Widget" — implementation, accessibility, mobile
  testing, data labeling, attribution, and SEO safeguards.

Every new article has a unique title and description, a canonical URL, visible
review date, GoldAlert Editorial Desk attribution, Article or HowTo structured
data, FAQ structured data, related internal links, primary-source references,
and an educational limitation statement.
